labelChirho: them, they (third person masculine plural pronoun)
descriptionChirho: Third person masculine plural pronoun הִמּוֹ used in both accusative ('them') and nominative ('they') functions. This is an archaic/poetic variant of the standard הֵם/הֵמָּה. Translated as English 'them/they,' Spanish 'ellos/a ellos,' Hindi 'unhen' (उन्हें), Arabic 'hum/iyyaha' (هُم/إِيّاها), Korean 'geudeul-eul/geudeul' (그들을/그들), Swahili 'wao.' The nominative and accusative uses represent the same pronoun in different syntactic positions, not distinct lexical senses. All 12 occurrences refer to the same pronominal function across case roles.
